Crazy
I was at some random party and this guy offered me some. Free drugs right? Sure I said he gave me two a hour later gave me two more. After a few hours I was feeling quite tweaker status very hyper then the tracers started kicking in an my vision was affected I decided to take a walk in the woods.. I was definitly feeling the pychedillic affects of the drug I decided to go back inside to my dorm room around 4 430 I took a shower and tried to calm down. I was laying down trying to calm down my mind was sporadic. My next memory is being cuffed then waking up in the hospital. Apparantly from what I heard I went naked and ran around my dorm room chasing ppl and yelling about existence and dinosaurs and jesus's third coming idk shits crazy -
shrooms are much better
